mentions.name: Coconut Water Review Site
mentions.description: A hobby website publishing coconut water reviews, with around 30 different brands reviewed so far. The reviews explore coconut water terroir, favoring unpasteurized water from young nam hom coconuts grown in central Thailand; the site is run for fun rather than profit.
mentions.source_excerpt: I made a website mostly to post  coconut water reviews. I never really liked coconut water until I tried an unpasteurized option and that led me to spiral down the rabbit hole of coconut water terroir.
mentions.author: mcbobgorge
